# Procedure

1. Read confirmed evidence, selected concept, and unresolved assumptions.
2. Define the product decision this skill owns.
3. State the product thesis and riskiest causal assumption.
4. Map the single critical user journey that can falsify the thesis.
5. Include only capabilities required to complete and measure that journey.
6. Define operational, security, accessibility, and recovery minimums that cannot be deferred.
7. Move every other capability to a later hypothesis with an explicit trigger for reconsideration.
8. Model alternatives and explicit trade-offs.
9. Choose a testable position with non-goals.
10. Trace the decision to users, value, risks, and metrics.
11. Publish the decision artifact and downstream invalidations.
